purpose: Static educational close-view candidate; independent acceptance and publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain paired open comb-like baskets, blue-green palette and distinct flap levels. Correct concept proportions: central carapace about trunk length, support appendages small12cm rather than giant graspers; exactly five long endites on each seven-podomere support. Ten flap-bearing trunksegments plus one blunt terminal. Restrained eyes explicitly inferred, no preserved eye anatomy claimed.

Long pointed anterior and rounded posterior central carapace with low median ridge and paired downward posterior extensions; two smaller convex lateral shields. Wide box-shaped tapering trunk. Eleven trunk segments; first ten each bear a dorsal pair of recurved pointed flaps and a ventral pair of rounded triangular flaps. Blunt terminal segment without flaps, no tailfan. Ten transverse dorsal setal-blade bands. Two small frontal support appendages, each seven podomeres, five long inward-inclining filtering endites on five intermediate podomeres, shorter proximal comb spine and downturned terminal tip without long endite. Each long endite has70 simplified main setae; no predatory claws. Early Ordovician Fezouata Morocco, not Cambrian despite pack naming. Species-level reconstruction informed by holotype YPM237172 and appendage YPM527125. Selected total longitudinal body/carapatial span about1.65m matches reported holotype1.6–1.7m reconstruction, not claim specimen preserved complete. Eyes inferred and absent from fossils; no oralcone invented. Fine secondary spinules omitted;70 main setal cues per long endite selected from reported at least70–80, not a universal exact count.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Actual device-renderer evidence required; CPU proof does not pass this stage.
Actual composed intended scene evidence required; unrun stays unknown.
